sourceReview:
Attested. Every function this slice ports was read in nethack-c/upstream before it was written: hack.c losehp() (4255-4292) and showdamage(), zap.c zhitu() (4400-4591) including the whole braced block at 4561-4589 and maybe_destroy_item() (5797-5954), zap.c dozap()'s gc.current_wand pair at 2672-2675, botl.c do_statusline1(), do_statusline2() (102-160) and bot_via_windowport()'s BL_HP store (1035-1041), pline.c vpline() (180-310), putmesg() (63-79) and urgent_pline() (313-323), win/tty/wintty.c tty_putstr()'s NHW_MESSAGE arm (2260-2300), win/tty/topl.c update_topl() (250-300), redotoplin() and show_topl(), apply.c catch_lit() (1577-1625), you.h:314-316 and role.c genders[] (688-696).

Two claims the handoff carried were checked and hold. The witness dies at zhitu()'s losehp() rather than maybe_destroy_item()'s: the recorded log at step 112 shows rn2(3)=2 at zhitu(zap.c:4436) and no further rnd(6), and the status falls from HP:11 to HP:0 in one screen. gb.buzzer has no writer anywhere in js/, confirmed by grep, so zhitu()'s first killer arm is unreachable.

One correction. The handoff expected the whole six-segment ray matrix to need re-recording; it did not. All six passed unchanged, because runFreshMatrix() records fresh C output on every run and no segment's inputs reached past the old refusal. What the slice needed was three more keys on the sixth segment.

One bug outside the slice's own lines had to be fixed for that segment to replay: js/zap.js's three `random = { d, rn1, rn2, rnd, rnl }` defaults carried no rne, and js/obj.js sourceRandom() requires one, so maybe_destroy_item() -> useup() -> weight() threw a TypeError for a destroyed stack of more than one item. The TypeError is not a class failClosedCommandRefusals() names, so it discarded the whole segment. Adding rne to the three defaults fixes it; no development session reached the path, because seed5002's destroyed potions are single items.
